what: Grab a photo row with staggered heights (odd cells at 80%) and drag it: the target piles up 2.5× the distance the hand moved, and the row chases it by .1 of the remaining distance each frame, gliding like inertia. Cells wrap at the row width and loop endlessly. Moving more than 10px vertically releases the drag so the page scrolls. When the mouse enters the board, a 10em accent-colored circle appears at the cursor’s upper right, growing from .4× and transparent over .4s cubic-bezier(.16,.5,.25,1) while the text ”DRAG” rises from below. The circle follows the cursor by .2 each frame. While dragging, the circle is .8×

options.accel: Fraction of the way the line follows its target (per frame), default .1
options.follow: Share of the distance the circle follows the cursor (per frame), default .2
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Row cell (photo box). Width is set by the css that uses it
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: (if present) circle following the cursor — one text inside

use: DRAG
note: Touch is listened to as passive only and never blocked (swiping vertically scrolls the page). The circle is position: fixed, so if a transform is applied to an ancestor of the board its position drifts

from.where: about.html [data-slot=craft-gallery] — original .c-carousel (power 2.5 · accel .1, odd cells 80%) + .c-cursor__circle[data-part=carousel](lerp .2, .4s ease-custom-out)
